categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and updates Guix release build manifests and patches under contrib/guix.
categories.rationale: Fixes a `ZeroDivisionError` failure when building the `guix-codesign` environment from source without substitutes on fast machines. While this resolves an environment build failure, it primarily affects source builds without substitutes rather than breaking mainline release builds or CI jobs.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The changes modify Guix release tooling, which the tools category explicitly assigns to build ('Build and release scripts are build').
categories.rationale: Not a member of tools; Guix code-signing manifests and patches belong to the build category.
